# NBAA - National Business Aviation Association

> > The National Business Aviation Association (NBAA) is the leading organization representing business aviation operators, advocating for industry interests, safety standards, and professional development.

NBAA serves as the primary advocacy and professional organization for business aviation in the United States, working closely with the FAA on regulatory matters, hosting major industry conventions, and providing educational programs through initiatives like the Professional Development Program (PDP). The association champions safety standards like IS-BAO and represents Part 91 operators and flight departments.

## Key Topics

- Business Aviation
- FAA Regulations and Reauthorization
- IS-BAO (International Standard for Business Aircraft Operations)
- Part 91 Operations
- Professional Development Program (PDP)
- NBAA Annual Convention
- Aviation Safety Standards
- RVSM (Reduced Vertical Separation Minimum)
- Aviation Education and Scholarships
- FAA User Fees and Funding
- Flight Department Operations
- EBACE (European Business Aviation Convention)
- Aviation Advocacy
- TFR (Temporary Flight Restrictions)

- [NBAA Urges Centennial Airport Users to Oppose Nearby Housing Plan](https://nbaa.org/press-releases/nbaa-urges-centennial-airport-users-to-oppose-nearby-housing-plan): NBAA calls for opposition to residential development near Centennial Airport
- [NBAA Cool to FAA's Pacific RVSM Rule](https://nbaa.org/press-releases/nbaa-cool-to-faas-pacific-rvsm-rule): NBAA responds to FAA Pacific RVSM regulation implementation
- [Veteran Aviation Industry Executive Bob Warren to Join NBAA Staff as EVP](https://nbaa.org/press-releases/veteran-aviation-industry-executive-bob-warren-to-join-nbaa-staff-as-evp): Bob Warren joins NBAA as EVP amid FAA fractional ownership regulations
